usage: agentware scaffold new [-h] [--format {text,json}]
                              --kind {loop-lib,module,panel,verb} --name NAME
                              [--layer {core,knowledge,retrieval,ops,features,cli}]
                              [--verb VERB] --task TASK [--dry-run] [--force]
                              [--no-regen]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --kind {loop-lib,module,panel,verb}
                        what kind of unit to emit
  --name NAME           the unit stem: lowercase letters and digits (e.g.
                        `planlint`)
  --layer {core,knowledge,retrieval,ops,features,cli}
                        the lib layer (required for --kind module/verb)
  --verb VERB           the top-level CLI verb (required for --kind verb)
  --task TASK           the plan task number this unit lands under; it is
                        recorded on the curated parity row, which the parity
                        schema refuses without one
  --dry-run             report every path the scaffold would claim, and write
                        nothing
  --force               overwrite an existing unit or test file
  --no-regen            skip the manifest and parity regenerators
